payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP from right counting good subsequences: for each valid start i, compute ways to pick the rest of the first good array using combinations C(j-1-i, k-1) and add d[j] for subsequent partitions.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 1D DP array d[i] for number of good sequences starting at i, with combinatorial transitions to choose remaining elements of the initial good array, fitting dp_counting_combinatorics.
